user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach census population attributes to the Centre County tract polygons using runtime-grounded schema fields.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the table and tract layer using runtime QC to ground the compatible join fields from observed schemas. Do not assume or hard-code join-key names.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate tract population and land area totals
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce one result for each census tract containing total population and geometry-derived land area.
workflow_steps.instructions: Aggregate the joined tract layer at the census-tract level. Retain the tract identifier, sum the population field, and calculate land area from valid tract geometry. Ground grouping and population field names from runtime schema evidence rather than guessing.

requirements.scope: The input census attribute table must contain the tract join field and population field needed for the attribute join and population total.
The joined tract features must retain valid polygon geometry so land area can be calculated.
